# Build demonstration inputs from their visible diagonal stripe specifications.
def stripe_grid(n, stripes):
 g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
 for key,color in stripes.items():
  for r in range(n):
   c=r+key
   if 0<=c<n:g[r][c]=color
 return g
# Demo 1: main 7 stripe c-r=-2, and 3 stripe snippets c-r=8/9.
d1=stripe_grid(10,{-2:7,8:3,9:3})
o1=mod.transform(d1)
e1=[[7 if (c-r)%3==1 else 3 for c in range(10)] for r in range(10)]
print('demo1 match',o1==e1)
# Demo 2 stripes c-r key -> color
d2=stripe_grid(23,{2:9,7:3,-3:3,16:7,17:2,-10:4,-13:1,-20:5})
o2=mod.transform(d2)
patt={0:7,1:2,2:9,3:1,4:5,5:3,6:4,7:3}
e2=[[patt[(c-r)%8] for c in range(23)] for r in range(23)]
print('demo2 match',o2==e2)
# inspect inferred pattern diagnostics if mismatch
if o1!=e1: print('d1 first row',o1[0],e1[0])
if o2!=e2: print('d2 first row',o2[0],e2[0])
